sources.excerpt: Chapter 5: Legislature WHY DO WE NEED A PARLIAMENT? Legislature is not merely a law making body. Lawmaking is but one 101 of the functions of the legislature. It is the centre of all democratic political process. It is packed with action; walkouts, protests, demonstration, unanimity, concern and co-operation. All these serve very vital purposes.
